text:
First working implementation increment completed, not full V0 replacement. Added estimates, estimates-io and fit-estimates; native selected shared OLS writes effects/marginal uncertainty with catalog IDs, exact readout/scans/df/provenance, explicit per-estimand validity, staged immutable publication, digest verification and CAS collection discovery. Reader has no fit dependency. Archive gained JVM streamed/prewritten local object primitives. Selected executor forward-port and canonical image bridge are in the working tree.

Evidence: docs/estimate-sets.md and docs/verification/estimate-set-increment/README.md. Retained exact source/provider patches, source SHA manifest and complete successful logs. Isolated candidate passes 711 JVM and 656 JS tests across image/dataset/fit/archive/new modules. Full scalafimCompileAll passed warning-clean in working tree with explicit provider override, distinct from isolated evidence. Separate 64 MiB writer and relocated reader handled 128 MiB numerical payload; independent Python verified all 16777216 values and validity bytes; no fitter on reader classpath.

Provider /tmp/estimate-image4s-provider is canonical image4s18ffdce plus tested incremental/refinement patch (core96/92 and NIfTI55/37 JVM/JS). Automatic approval review rejected commit/push because external publication requires explicit user authorization; asked user, no approval yet. No commit or push occurred. Default image4s pin lacks these APIs; current increment requires -Dscalafim.image4s.build=/tmp/estimate-image4s-provider until approved publication and exact pin requalification.

Open work: final canonical V0 schema/spec migration and fixtures, covariance/pooled persistence, additional geometry/gzip, HDF5, replacing old exporter and group/workflow coupling, PLS Neuro adoption, full crash/concurrency/performance matrix. Development schema is explicitly scalafim-estimates-development-1 and does not claim V0 interchange conformance. Old writer retained until extraction coverage exists. Concurrent HRF/AGENTS/Gale override work preserved and excluded from isolated source patch. Resume provider publication only after explicit approval, then pin/retest; continue remaining plan.
